issues.description: Incorrect indexing when building the middle distinct set. The inner loop uses `for j in range(i, N): middle_set.add(A[j-1])` and only skips computing the sum when `j == i`. That causes A[i-1] (the last element of the left segment) to be added to `middle_set` for every i, so the "middle" distinct count is computed over the wrong elements.

Algorithmic complexity is still quadratic (O(N^2)) in the worst case: the code iterates over all pairs (i,j) with an inner loop that grows with N and maintains a set per i. With N up to 3·10^5 this will not finish within time limits (TLE) and therefore does not meet acceptance criteria CA-01 / CA-02.
No test files or automated checks were provided in the workspace to validate correctness, edge cases or performance (unit/integration tests missing).

There are no tests exercising critical cases (large N, worst-case patterns, and representative edge cases). Tests that prove the algorithm meets the required time limit and correctness for edge cases are absent.
